lede: Wat Klang accounts for 64 catalogued manuscripts, 12 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phrae (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (94%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (80%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (20%). Dated witnesses run 1818–1966 CE (35 of 64 carry a date).
